formally_verified_invariants.name: Election Safety
formally_verified_invariants.statement: At most one leader can be elected and active in any given term T.

formally_verified_invariants.name: Committed Log Consistency
formally_verified_invariants.statement: If two coordinators contain an entry at term T and index I, their log prefixes are identical.

formally_verified_invariants.name: Leader Completeness
formally_verified_invariants.statement: Any log entry committed at term T and index I is present in all leaders of terms > T.

formally_verified_invariants.name: No Unauthorized Committed Mutation (P0 Fencing)
formally_verified_invariants.statement: Storage nodes only accept and store mutations authorized by a valid QuorumMutationPermit with >= 2 signatures at epoch >= node watermark.

formally_verified_invariants.name: Manifest Generation Monotonicity
formally_verified_invariants.statement: For any object, committed manifest generations strictly advance and never regress or rollback.

formally_verified_invariants.name: Fail-Closed Quorum Loss
formally_verified_invariants.statement: A minority or isolated partitioned leader cannot commit entries or acquire mutation permits.

formally_verified_invariants.name: Crash Recovery Consistency
formally_verified_invariants.statement: Crashed and recovered coordinators strictly preserve committed entries up to commit_index without rollback.

formally_verified_invariants.name: Operation Idempotency
formally_verified_invariants.statement: Duplicate execution of identical request_id produces cached status and does not advance generation or duplicate mutations.

formally_verified_invariants.name: Repair Journal Consistency
formally_verified_invariants.statement: Candidate coordinators reset/invalidate pending repair jobs from previous terms upon election to prevent stale repair overwrites.

formally_verified_invariants.name: No Committed Metadata Rollback
formally_verified_invariants.statement: Snapshot installation and state replay strictly reject snapshots with snapshot_index < commit_index.
